zh:notifyChooser.suits.en: The ones that suit {osName} are ticked.

zh:notifyChooser.notify.note.text: 简短命令可直接在横幅上允许、拒绝或回复。
zh:notifyChooser.notify.note.en: Allow, Deny or Reply right on the banner for short commands.

zh:notifyChooser.receipt.note.text: 较长的任务完成后，给你一份简短摘要。
zh:notifyChooser.receipt.note.en: A short summary when a longer job finishes.

zh:notifyChooser.tray.note.text: 一个小面板，列出需要你处理的事，点一下就能打开。
zh:notifyChooser.tray.note.en: A small panel with what needs you, one click away.

zh:notifyChooser.pill.note.text: 有事需要你处理时，屏幕顶部出现一个小胶囊条。
zh:notifyChooser.pill.note.en: A small pill at the top of the screen when something needs you.

zh:notifyChooser.badge.windows.text: 任务栏角标和跳转列表

zh:notifyChooser.badge.note.text: 图标上显示数量，右键点击图标可使用快捷操作。
zh:notifyChooser.badge.note.en: A count on the icon, and quick actions when you right-click it.

zh:notifyChooser.bubble.note.text: 在屏幕边缘放一个机器人的头像，需要你时会出现一个圆点。
zh:notifyChooser.bubble.note.en: One bot's avatar at the edge of the screen, with a dot when it needs you.

zh:notifyChooser.dock.note.text: 所有机器人排成一条，放在屏幕边缘。
zh:notifyChooser.dock.note.en: Every bot in a strip at the edge of the screen.

zh:notifyChooser.shortcut.note.text: 一个组合键，用来打开需要你处理的内容。
zh:notifyChooser.shortcut.note.en: One key combination that opens what needs you.

zh:notifyChooser.setInSettings.text: 请在设置的“通知我”下选择按键。
zh:notifyChooser.setInSettings.en: Pick the key in Settings, under Notify me.

zh:notifyChooser.reason.macOnly.en: This one is for the Mac.

zh:notifyChooser.reason.wayland.text: 需要 X11 会话：Wayland 无法让它保持在最前面。
zh:notifyChooser.reason.wayland.en: Needs an X11 session: Wayland cannot keep it on top.

zh:notifyChooser.reason.noTrayHost.text: 这个桌面没有可用来显示它的托盘。
zh:notifyChooser.reason.noTrayHost.en: This desktop has no tray to show it in.

zh:notifyChooser.reason.portalNeeded.text: 需要桌面的快捷键门户。

zh:notifyChooser.linuxLockNote.text: 按钮需要这个桌面报告锁屏状态。
zh:notifyChooser.linuxLockNote.en: The buttons need this desktop to report its lock state.

zh:notifyChooser.sharingLine.text: 在 Murage 能检测到的应用里共享屏幕时，Murage 会隐藏自己的窗口。
zh:notifyChooser.sharingLine.en: Murage hides its own windows while you share your screen in the apps it can detect.

zh:notifyChooser.keepInside.text: 暂时全部留在 Murage 里
zh:notifyChooser.keepInside.en: Keep everything inside Murage for now

zh:notifyChooser.errorLoad.text: 无法读取你的通知选择。你可以稍后在设置里决定。
zh:notifyChooser.errorLoad.en: Could not read your notification choices. You can set them later in Settings.

zh:notifyChooser.errorSave.text: 无法保存你的选择。请重试，或稍后在设置里决定。
zh:notifyChooser.errorSave.en: Could not save your choices. Try again, or set them later in Settings.

zh:notifyMe.intro.text: Murage 联系你的方式：{of} 项中已开 {on} 项。每个开关一拨动就会保存在这台电脑上。
zh:notifyMe.intro.en: Where Murage reaches you: {on} of {of} on. Each switch saves on this computer as you flip it.

zh:notifyMe.finishedOff.text: 任务完成通知已关闭。打开“任务完成”即可收到回执。
zh:notifyMe.finishedOff.en: Notifications for finished jobs are off. Turn on Task completed to get receipts.

zh:notifyMe.errorLoad.text: 无法读取你的通知选择。
zh:notifyMe.errorLoad.en: Could not read your notification choices.

zh:notifyMe.errorSave.en: Could not save that. Try again.

zh:notifyMe.notifyActions.help.text: 简短命令可直接在横幅上允许、拒绝或回复。
zh:notifyMe.notifyActions.help.en: Allow, Deny or Reply right on the banner for short commands.

zh:notifyMe.quietSummary.text: 免打扰时段结束时的摘要

zh:notifyMe.quietSummary.help.text: 用一行说明你不在时有多少件事在等你。
zh:notifyMe.quietSummary.help.en: One line saying how many things waited while you were away.

zh:notifyMe.hideFullscreen.text: 使用全屏应用时隐藏 Murage 的窗口

zh:notifyMe.hideFullscreen.help.text: Murage 自己的窗口不会挡住全屏应用。
zh:notifyMe.hideFullscreen.help.en: Murage's own windows stay out of the way of a full-screen app.

zh:notifyMe.respectFocus.text: 遵守专注模式和勿扰模式
zh:notifyMe.respectFocus.en: Respect Focus and Do Not Disturb

zh:notifyMe.respectFocus.help.text: 这台电脑这样设置时，Murage 保持安静。
zh:notifyMe.respectFocus.help.en: Murage stays quiet when this computer is set to.

zh:notifyMe.badgeMenu.help.text: 右键点击图标，可为你的 Chief 新建任务、暂停自动化，以及打开“需要你处理”。
zh:notifyMe.badgeMenu.help.en: New task for your Chief, Pause automations and Open Needs you when you right-click the icon.

zh:notifyMe.receiptMin.text: 任务至少持续多久才显示回执
zh:notifyMe.receiptMin.en: Show a receipt when a job takes at least

zh:notifyMe.nudge.text: 有事在等时，隔多久提醒我
zh:notifyMe.nudge.en: Remind me about something waiting after
